requirements.summary: Require Internet Identity authentication before any calendar data is accessible, with a clear sign-in prompt and per-user profile setup.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users see a clear sign-in prompt and cannot access calendar content.
Authenticated users can access their own calendar content.

file_operations.description: Create the root app component that gates all calendar UI behind Internet Identity authentication (show a sign-in screen when unauthenticated, and the calendar UI only when authenticated). Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for login gating; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a login/logout button using Internet Identity via the existing useInternetIdentity hook. Ensure logout clears React Query cached data. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for the login/logout UX; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a React Query hook that loads the caller profile (getCallerUserProfile) once an authenticated actor is available, and exposes loading/fetched flags that avoid profile-setup modal flash. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for profile queries; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a compact modal prompting for a display name on first login, saving it via saveCallerUserProfile. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for first-time profile setup; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the new App.tsx into the existing app entry and ensure QueryClient + InternetIdentityProvider remain wrapped around the app so authentication state is available globally.

requirements.summary: Encrypt/decrypt event/task content client-side using Web Crypto with a passphrase-derived key, ensuring ciphertext-only storage and passphrase required on reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Events and tasks are encrypted in the browser before being sent to the backend.
The backend stores only encrypted payloads and required non-sensitive metadata (e.g., IDs, timestamps), not plaintext content.
On reload, the app requires the passphrase to decrypt and display existing events/tasks for the signed-in user.

file_operations.description: Define shared types for encrypted payload packaging (e.g., AES-GCM iv, ciphertext, versioning fields) to be serialized into the encryptedTitle/encryptedDescription/encryptedDetails strings stored in the backend.

Implement Web Crypto utilities: per-user salt generation/storage, PBKDF2 key derivation from user passphrase, and AES-GCM authenticated encryption/decryption helpers that serialize/deserialize to/from strings safe for backend storage.

Create a small session hook that holds the derived CryptoKey in-memory only (no persistent storage), exposes locked/unlocked state, and supports explicit lock on logout so reload always requires re-entering passphrase.

Add a modal that prompts for a passphrase after authentication and before showing decrypted calendar content; on success derives the key and unlocks the session; on failure shows an error and remains locked.

Implement mapping helpers that convert between plaintext UI models and backend encrypted models: encrypt fields before mutations; decrypt fields after queries; keep non-sensitive metadata (timestamps/completion/deadline) unencrypted.
Integrate the passphrase unlock flow: after authenticated + profile-ready, require passphrase entry before rendering any decrypted events/tasks UI, and ensure locking occurs on logout.

requirements.summary: Build a compact UI with minimal navigation supporting event month/week viewing and a task list, plus lightweight create/edit forms for both.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can add/edit/delete an event from the UI.
Users can add/edit/delete a task from the UI.
The UI remains compact with only the necessary screens to manage events and tasks.

file_operations.description: Create a compact application shell with minimal navigation (e.g., two tabs: Events, Tasks) and a small header area for profile name + LoginButton.
Create the Events view that provides a minimal month display with selectable day and a simple week/list toggle for events, showing decrypted titles/descriptions only when unlocked.
Add a lightweight create/edit dialog for events (start/end time, title, description). Ensure edit pre-fills decrypted values and save re-encrypts before sending.
Create the Tasks view that shows a compact list with completion toggle and optional deadline, using decrypted title/details only when unlocked.
Add a lightweight create/edit dialog for tasks (title, details, optional deadline). Ensure edit pre-fills decrypted values and save re-encrypts before sending.
Wire the Shell + EventsView + TasksView into the authenticated/unlocked application area so there are no orphan screens/components.

requirements.summary: Use React Query for all calendar server interactions with loading/error states and immediate UI updates after mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: During fetch/mutations, the UI shows a loading state and handles errors with a visible message.
After creating/updating/deleting an item, the list reflects the change without requiring a manual refresh.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for listing events/tasks using the actor (getEvents/getTasks) and for mutations (add/delete/update). Include query keys scoped to the authenticated principal and ensure errors are surfaced in the UI.

Implement mutation helpers that (1) encrypt plaintext using the encryption session before calling backend functions and (2) invalidate/refetch relevant list queries on success (or apply optimistic updates where safe).

Integrate React Query list + mutations with explicit loading and error states (e.g., list skeleton/spinner, inline error banner) and ensure the events list updates immediately after create/edit/delete.
Integrate React Query list + mutations with explicit loading and error states and ensure the task list updates immediately after create/edit/delete and completion toggles.

Align frontend typing with required calendar interactions by adding any missing calendar-related backend function signatures needed by the UI (e.g., event/task update functions if available in the deployed backend), so React Query hooks can be type-safe.

requirements.summary: Apply a coherent compact visual theme (non-blue/purple primary palette) consistently across the app.
acceptanceCriteria: All screens share a consistent visual system (colors/typography/layout).
Primary styling does not use a blue/purple dominant palette.

file_operations.description: Update global CSS variables (primary/secondary/accent/sidebar/chart) to a non-blue/purple dominant palette (e.g., charcoal + green/amber) and adjust base typography/spacing tokens to support a compact productivity UI.
Create a src-level stylesheet imported by main.tsx that forwards/includes the real global styles (frontend/index.css) so theming is applied reliably without changing immutable UI component paths.
Ensure Tailwind theme usage remains aligned with CSS variable tokens and that the configured design system supports the updated non-blue/purple palette consistently across components.
Apply consistent spacing, typography, and component styling in the shell (header, tabs, content container) to match the updated theme and keep the UI compact.
